properties.description: A lowercase version of the node name, with no whitespace included. Used for indexing & search.

properties.description:
Path of this node, relative to the parent node (if defined) or the API root (if no parent is defined).

properties.name: parent id
properties.description:
ID of the node that appears directly above/before this node on the path.
